name: CsoundQt
blurb: CsoundQt is a feature-rich, cross-platform frontend and IDE for csound.
description:
CsoundQt is a feature-rich, cross-platform frontend and IDE for csound. csound itself
is a powerful sound synthesis and music programming language.

It provides a syntax-highlighting code editor with autocomplete,
interactive widget panels for real-time control, an integrated debugger,
quick access to help for any opcode, MIDI and OSC support and a variety
of tools for composing and performing

CsoundQt ships with an extensive collection of examples covering everything
from basic synthesis techniques to advanced signal processing

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
